npcs.name: Bramble
npcs.idle: Waters the terrace pots and hums

lines.text: Oh! A flier! The wheat's been waiting for someone who can reach the high rows.
Moonwheat, sunberries, cloudcotton. Fly low over a ripe row and it gives itself to you.

npcs.name: Hollis
npcs.idle: Hammers a glowing blade, sparks like fireflies

lines.text: Bring me frostglass and essence and I'll fold the wind into steel for you.

npcs.name: Old Reed
npcs.idle: Naps on the harbour steps with a rod in hand

lines.text: Mm? Ah. The minnows are running in the cloud sea tonight. You've a rod?

npcs.name: Ingrid
npcs.idle: Taps the cavern walls and listens

lines.text: The Deeps sing if you listen. Frostspine first, little flier. Then we talk.

npcs.name: Celeste
npcs.idle: Traces constellations in the air with one finger

lines.text: Every star is a note. Trace them in order and the Loom will sing for you.

npcs.name: Master Pei
npcs.idle: Pours tea from a great height without spilling a drop

lines.text: Patience is the first leaf in every pot. Sit, if you like.

npcs.name: Maris
npcs.idle: Turns three glyph stones over and over in the current

lines.text: Three of a kind, and the pedestal makes one that remembers all three.

npcs.name: Tobin
npcs.idle: Measures a plank twice, then once more

lines.text: Ashwind's light and honest. Bring me logs and I'll show you the bench.

npcs.name: Penny
npcs.idle: Stacks coins into neat little towers

lines.text: Your coins are safe with me. Every last one. I counted twice.
Buying or selling? The Lantern Market's open from dawn to the last lantern.

npcs.name: Skip
npcs.idle: Bounces on their toes, satchel full of letters

lines.text: Letters, parcels, gossip! I fly faster than any of them. Almost as fast as you.

npcs.name: Wick
npcs.idle: Carries a long pole and lights the lanterns at dusk

lines.text: Every lantern I light is a little less dark for someone. Have you seen any lost lights out there?
They hide in the strangest places. Under arches. Behind waterfalls. Listen for the hum.
